incident.description: The service cannot reach its database after a configuration change.

delegations.task: Analyze the captured configuration change for deviations in database connection parameters that may have caused the service to lose connectivity.

hypotheses.trigger: The service configuration changed to use port 6433 in settings.json, while the input specifies a listening port of 5432.
hypotheses.mechanism: The service compares the configured port in settings.json to the listening port in input.json. When the port in settings.json (6433) does not match the listening_port (5432) in input.json, the assertion fails, causing the service to terminate before attempting a connection.
hypotheses.effect: The service fails to establish a database connection and raises an AssertionError.
hypotheses.next_check: Verify if the database server is configured to listen on port 6433.
